pages.text: Draconic armour is a single $(item)Chestpiece$() in Wyvern, Draconic and Chaotic tiers. On its own it is a diamond-grade chestplate; its strength comes from $(l:equipment/modules)modules$(/l), above all the energy shield. If Curios is installed it can also be worn in a Curios slot.$(br2)Its grid holds most body modules: shield, Undying, Flight, Speed, Jump, Auto Feed, Night Vision and more.

pages.title: Energy shield
pages.text: Install a $(l)Shield Control$() module to get a shield (one per chestpiece). Add $(l)Shield Capacity$() modules for more shield points, $(l)Large Shield Capacity$() for many points in one 2x2 module, and $(l)Shield Recovery$() for faster recharge.$(br2)The shield soaks up damage before your health. After a hit it waits out a cooldown (shorter on higher tier controllers), then recharges using energy.

pages.title: Shield upkeep
pages.text: Holding the shield up also costs a little energy, more the bigger it is. If the chestpiece runs dry, the shield fades away over about a minute. Keep plenty of energy modules, or an Energy Link, in the same grid.

pages.title: Undying
pages.text: When a fatal hit lands and the module is charged, $(l)Undying$() cancels the death, heals you, adds a short shield boost and gives a moment of invulnerability. Draconic and Chaotic modules also clear harmful effects.$(br2)It then recharges from the chestpiece: 2 minutes and 5M OP (Wyvern), 1 minute and 10M OP (Draconic), 45 seconds and 20M OP (Chaotic).

pages.title: Flight
pages.text: The Wyvern $(l)Flight$() module gives elytra flight. Draconic and Chaotic also give creative-style flight, unless the server turned that off. A Toggle Flight key can be bound in Controls.$(br2)Chestpieces are fusion crafted from a diamond chestplate up through each tier.
